en-US.longDescription: PyMODA is a Python implementation of MODA (Multiscale Oscillatory Dynamics Analysis), a numerical toolbox developed by the Nonlinear & Biomedical Physics group at Lancaster University and the Nonlinear Dynamics and Synergetic Group at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, University of Ljubljana, Slovenia under the supervision of Aneta Stefanovska.
en-US.name: PyMODA
